description: Lemma aggregation edge-case scenarios: hapax in isolated corpus, all-doc lemma with non-uniform frequency, empty document, multi-frequency stress, all-empty corpus.
notes: Wave 2 closes four C03 gaps: (1) hapax verified only in context of multi-lemma corpus — now also in isolation; (2) all-doc lemma existed (גדול in C03) but with uniform per-doc frequency — now tested with non-uniform; (3) empty document behavior unpinned; (4) overlapping multi-frequency stress case missing. Each scenario is a self-contained corpus. Oracle: pure Python simulation, no DB. DB-level aggregation service is a separate integration test layer.

scenarios.description: Single-doc single-occurrence lemma — hapax in isolation. Proves minimum freq=1, docs=1 case.

expected_aggregates.notes: Single occurrence in single document. freq=1, docs=1. docs ≤ freq (1 ≤ 1).

invariants.name: total_tokens_match
invariants.description: Sum of freq values == total token count

scenarios.notes: Minimal corpus. Docs ≤ Freq holds (1 ≤ 1). Classification: Correct by design.

scenarios.description: All-doc lemma with non-uniform per-doc frequency. Proves docs == corpus_size and freq >> docs.

expected_aggregates.notes: 2x in DOC_A + 1x in DOC_B + 3x in DOC_C = freq 6; in all 3 docs. Non-uniform per-doc frequency (2, 1, 3). docs = corpus_size = 3.
1x only in DOC_B. Hapax embedded in multi-doc corpus.

invariants.name: total_tokens_match
invariants.description: Sum of freq values == total token count

scenarios.notes: שלום freq=6 > docs=3. Non-uniform per-doc counts (2,1,3) confirm no per-doc averaging confusion. Classification: Correct by design.

scenarios.description: Corpus with one empty document. Empty doc must not inflate docs count or token sum.

expected_aggregates.notes: 2x in DOC_A + 0x in DOC_B (empty) + 1x in DOC_C = freq 3; only 2 docs contain ספר. docs=2 not 3 despite 3 doc_ids existing.

invariants.name: total_tokens_match
invariants.description: Sum of freq values == total non-empty token count

scenarios.notes: DOC_B has no tokens. By design: empty doc contributes 0 to freq and 0 to docs. docs=2, freq=3, total=3. Classification: Correct by design.

scenarios.description: Multi-frequency stress: one lemma with high freq/low docs, one all-doc lemma with freq==docs, one hapax.

expected_aggregates.notes: 5x in DOC_A + 3x in DOC_B = freq 8; only in 2 docs. High freq, low docs — stress test against docs=freq confusion.
1x in each of 3 docs = freq 3; in all 3 docs. freq == docs (each doc contributes exactly 1). All-doc lemma with uniform single-occurrence per doc.
1x in DOC_C only. Hapax embedded in stress corpus.

invariants.name: total_tokens_match
invariants.description: Sum of freq values == total token count

scenarios.notes: Three-lemma stress corpus. ארץ: freq=8 >> docs=2 (tests against accidentally setting docs=freq). עם: freq=3 == docs=3 (each doc exactly 1 occurrence — tests that this edge is correct). מים: hapax. Classification: Correct by design.

scenarios.description: All documents are empty — no tokens anywhere. Expected: no aggregates produced.

invariants.name: total_tokens_match
invariants.description: Sum of freq values == 0 for all-empty corpus

scenarios.notes: All docs have no tokens. By design: no lemma rows produced, total_token_count=0. The docs ≤ freq invariant vacuously holds (no rows). Classification: Correct by design.
